name: Motor City Turf Wars
storyline:
You start with nothing on a rough Detroit corner. A burner phone, a few seeds and a stash house are your way up.

The streets are full of junk dealers selling bad product and tearing the blocks apart. You are going to do it better. You sell clean, you treat your clients right, and you take the corners back one hood at a time.
summary: Motor City Turf Wars is a top-down crime sandbox set in Detroit, played in the browser. You start with nothing and build a street operation: grow and sell weed, text clients on a burner phone, run a stash house and put together a crew. Rival gangs hold the neighborhoods. You can take out their dealers, start turf wars and claim the hoods while keeping police heat down. You drive cars, fight with fists, bats and guns, and tag walls with spray paint.
